name: flowchart
about: A checkout flowchart with sentence-long node labels, decision diamonds and labelled edges, drawn twice: once through graph (layered, top to bottom) and once through a Mermaid flowchart with a subgraph (left to right). Node boxes are the fixed 160x60 today.

nodes.text: Shopper presses Pay now on the cart page
Validate the session token and the CSRF cookie
Is the payment provider reachable within 800 ms?
Charge the saved card through the provider API
Write the order to the orders database (Postgres 17 primary)
Show a retry banner and keep the cart intact for 30 minutes
Send the confirmation e-mail with the invoice PDF attached

ops.title: Refund flow
ops.source:
flowchart LR
  req([Customer asks for a refund through the support widget]) --> policy{Is the order younger than thirty days?}
  policy -->|yes| auto[Refund automatically to the original payment method]
  policy -->|no| human[Escalate to a human agent in the Tier-2 queue]
  subgraph ledger [Ledger and notifications]
    auto --> book[Book a negative ledger entry with the reason code]
    human --> book
    book --> notify[Notify the customer and the accounting mailbox]
  end
  notify --> closed((Closed))
